description.value: Neptune Eats is a Cantonese-style restaurant in Vancouver's Kerrisdale neighbourhood, specializing in Hong Kong-style cuisine with a menu spanning breakfast through dinner and seafood feasts. The restaurant operates bilingually in English and Chinese and offers both dine-in and online ordering with pickup. It sits on West 41st Avenue, a quiet residential commercial strip popular with local cyclists.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 40m; stands (2 spaces) at 56m; bollard (2 spaces) at 60m; bollard (2 spaces) at 61m; bollard (2 spaces) at 70m; bollard (2 spaces) at 82m. Total: 14 spaces.
